name: Agur
overview: Agur is a male biblical figure identified uniquely as the son of Jakeh and recognized as an oracle. His mention is limited to Proverbs 30:1, where he is introduced without tribal affiliation or additional personal details. As an oracle, Agur is associated with delivering inspired wisdom within the biblical text.
namesAndTitles: The name Agur means 'gatherer' or possibly 'wage earner,' indicating a name of Hebrew origin with practical connotations. This proper name is not described as given by God but serves to identify this individual in Scripture.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records that Agur is the son of Jakeh. Beyond this paternal relationship, no other family connections or relational details are provided in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Agur's significance lies in his role as the author of a section of wisdom literature within Proverbs, where he is presented as an inspired oracle. His contributions enrich the biblical wisdom tradition by offering reflections and teachings that complement the broader themes of Proverbs. Although little is known about his background, Agur's inclusion highlights the diversity of voices inspired by God to convey His truth.
